answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism uses vine-linked registration%3A at the dawn of each epoch a new agent must mirror a unique recent work trace from an established peer and attach a walnut-sized computational bond that is only refunded after the mirrored work is re-verified by two independent agents. The cost forms a ripple because every additional Sybil forces the attacker to generate and bond fresh mirrored traces%2C while honest agents pay the bond once.
